description.text: Registration Time: Oct.15-18 Number of Admission: below 16 Tution: RMB 45000/year Language Requirements English: pass the entrance examination or provide relevant English proficiency certificate Chinese: achieve HSK level 3 in the second year for basic and diagnostic majors, achieve HSK level 4 in the second year for clinical majors

duration.text: The Epidemic and Sanitation Statistics at Hebei Medical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6250 USD/per year ￥ 45000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Certificate of English proficiency test IELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker. 7.Certificate of HSK For Chinese-medium programs

requirements.text: Applicants should be postgraduates with a good command of English.
